title: Inside the Vault: Edition #1
summary: Welcome to the first edition of Inside the Vault, designed to keep you locked in on all things Courtyard and collecting.
body_markdown:
Welcome to the first edition of *Inside the Vault* , designed to keep you locked in on all things Courtyard and collecting.


In case you’re new,[Courtyard](http://courtyard.io/) is the easiest way to bring your IRL collectibles onchain to showcase and trade anywhere in web3. We’ve been up to a lot lately, so let’s get into it 👇


## **Vault and tokenize your collection. Earn 1% passive income.**


The wait is over and our Brink’s vault is officially open. It’s time to tokenize and vault your graded cards- **for free!**[Get started ➜](https://courtyard.io/)


## Elevate your collection and profits


Showcase your cards like never before with stunning 3D models that elevate your cards and profits. Use promo 🎟️ **FREECARD** to digitize your first card for free![Digitize your collection ➜](https://digitize.courtyard.io/discount/FREECARD)
